description: Explicitly curated overseas retail size-class search aliases for actual factory ml capacities. These are approximate marketing classes, NOT physical capacities in US fluid ounces. Actual catalog ml remains authoritative.
notes: Sourced market labels such as 24, 32, 40, 64, and 128 oz are established search categories; other less common aliases are editorial size classes rather than verified marketplace standards.
Do not write 1000ml=32USfl oz, 2000ml=64USfl oz, or 750ml=24USfl oz as exact physical conversions.
For new capacities not reviewed in this table, find an eligible familiar retail class within maxRelativeDifference; if no safe class, skip the size-class alias until the source list is reviewed.
